name: MBX
long_description: MBX (formerly Memebox) is a multi-brand beauty and personal care startup headquartered in San Francisco. The venture-backed company has raised over $190M in funding from prominent investors, including Formation 8 & Group, Goodwater Capital, Johnson & Johnson, Pear VC, Y Combinator, and other Silicon Valley VCs. Memebox operates a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands that are co-developed with strategic partners like Sephora and Ulta, using data-driven insights to identify white space opportunities in the market. The company’s products are made in Korea, leveraging the latest K-beauty innovations in the formula, packaging, and speed-to-market. MBX has offices in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and Taipei, and its brands include Kaja, I Dew Care, Pony Effect, I’m Meme, and Nooni.
one_liner: A global multi-brand beauty and personal care startup.

name: Function of Beauty
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; New York, NY, USA
long_description: We’re a customized beauty brand at the intersection of tech and beauty, setting out to democratize custom beauty and truly empower individuality. There’s no one size fits all with us.
one_liner: Customizable beauty for hair, skin, and body care products.

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Function of Beauty was created by beauty outsiders: two MIT grads and a chemist who believed that everyone deserves a custom product and should be empowered to create their own beauty journey. Engineer and MIT grad Zahir Dossa was trained to see problems as equations to be solved. But when he looked at the beauty industry, what he saw didn’t add up—real people were more than broad categories like “curls” or “dry,” so cookie-cutter solutions could never deliver transformational results. No wonder consumers never saw the results they were after. But making effective, customized products at scale was thought to be impossible.   Zahir teamed up with fellow MIT grad Josh Maciejewski and cosmetic chemist Hien Nguyen, combining their expertise in supply chain, sustainability, and data science to create something revolutionary in the beauty industry. They imagined enabling every consumer to create their own product based on a totally customized set of variables, made to order with bespoke craftsmanship and care. They imagined an algorithm-based approach that would let them constantly iterate and improve every formula. The most important variable at the center of their equation was the consumer, who—for the first time—could be honored with formulas as one-of-a-kind as they were.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: We built a pioneering production facility and algorithm that allowed customers to co-create perfect, freshly crafted hair care formulas.  We focus on select, targeted, high-performing ingredients, expertly combined to work for optimal efficacy. We deliver freshly formulated, customized hair care right to customers, minimizing waste and ensuring you get everything they need  — and nothing they don’t.After building a successful DTC business, we set out to become an omni-channel pioneer and bring customization to the brick and mortar environment. In 2020, we designed and introduced a new concept and behavior for consumers - giving them options to mix their own custom shampoo and conditioner at home.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: At Function of Beauty, our mission is to truly empower individuality and we are the first brand to deliver on this promise by offering a fully personalized response to the vast diversity of hair and skin goals that women and men have. There is no one size fits all product, and we believe customization is the ultimate response to consuming more sustainably by having the perfect product made just for you. Customization is a challenging task that most beauty brands have not been able to figure out. We developed a unique technology and manufacturing capability which allows us to create custom formulas at scale.  We saw an opportunity to make a difference.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: We often get the question about how big is big for customization. We believe we are at the beginning of a fundamental evolution of customer behavior. Customization is  the future of beauty. It is a sustainable response to the consumer evolution and changing complexity of their beauty needs.  Today, nearly everyone can have access to custom formulas for their unique hair, skin and body needs. We want to continue to democratize access to custom beauty products over the next few years.

name: Lygg
long_description: Up to 90% of skin aging is caused by UV light from the sun. Most of this is caused by UVA light and only two FDA-approved chemical ingredients protect against it, one of which is neither photostable nor GRASE. To address this, we have developed a patented, photostable, and safe ingredient that can dramatically increase current UVA protection.
one_liner: Building New Anti-Aging Ingredients for Skincare

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Graham Dick is the CEO and co-founder of Lygg. Originally from Vancouver, Canada, Graham obtained his PhD in Chemistry from Stanford University and previously served as a postdoctoral researcher at EPFL in Lausanne, Switzerland. Following the ban of two common sunscreen ingredients in Hawaii and due to increasing concerns regarding the skin penetration of the remaining ingredients, Graham founded Lygg in 2020 to create a new generation of safe, innovative sunscreen ingredients.

launches.title: Telemetron: The Support Platform that Understands Hardware
launches.tagline: Product Support, Troubleshooting, and Debugging for Hardware Companies
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95195&key=user_uploads/1382504/8e149fc6-6d08-468e-9867-3f7e72a234c9)

### The Team:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95195&key=user_uploads/1382504/e6ac658e-26f8-4e6f-959c-5af6bd9b7c6c)

Shivani and Hamza worked together at SpaceX on the Starlink Software team. \
\
**Shivani:** \
Shivani was the first software engineer on the Starlink customer support team. She built all the AI support software tooling from scratch as a solo-engineer. She built the Starlink app/web chatbots, an AI copilot for internal teams and support agents, a telemetry enabled root causing system, and much more! She helped take AI automation at Starlink from 0 to 70%. \
\
**Hamza:** \
Hamza built internal tooling to manage Starlink’s multi-billion dollar ecommerce flow and solved global customer issues. He built the internal localization framework, payments infrastructure, SEO, content management, and much more

### The Problem:

For hardware products, post-sales support is more than just replying to emails and working tickets. **50-80% of customer issues are tightly coupled with what is happening on devices.** Resolutions require in person service, warranty checks, returns & replacements (RMAs), video calls, and root-causing defective hardware.

At SpaceX, we evaluated over 20 customer support companies and ended up needing to build our own.  When talking to other hardware companies, we found every hardware company faces the same problem.

1. **Support agents aren’t technical enough to troubleshoot.** _Companies have to provide extensive training to prevent escalations to software / hardware teams_
2. **Legacy support software like Zendesk / Intercom are built for b2b SAAS.** _Hardware companies are forced to build software tools from scratch_

### The Solution:

# Telemetron: End-To-End Support Platform for Hardware Companies. We handle product support, troubleshooting, field service management, and more.

\
https://youtu.be/817uAVqoOWY

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95195&key=user_uploads/1382504/5aeda9dc-ee66-4b9e-853d-d7d9be0f83b2)

**Internal Agent Copilot:** \
Integrations to connect your AI agent to your device telemetry, 3PL systems, ecommerce flows, and everything else needed to run a hardware company post-sales. Our agents are built to process and debug complex hardware data and docs.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95195&key=user_uploads/1382504/0c96b639-b1db-49e1-b7e2-2598249f587e)

\
**Modern, Hardware-Friendly Customer Help Center + Chat:** \
Help Center and AI Chatbot that’s built for hardware. AI Agents that understand firmware revisions, product manuals, design docs. Easy to add pictures and videos for setup guides, troubleshooting docs, and product manuals

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95195&key=user_uploads/1382504/136d1d3f-24f1-4373-bac3-c22b071ca3a1)

**And so much more!**

* Field Service Management: Software tools for technicians providing in person support for hardware devices
* Warranty Eligibility and Management software
* RMA Eligibility and Management
* Hardware evaluations Post-RMA
* Omni-channel support (phone, email, text with i-Message, video calls)

### Let's Talk!!

If you’re building hardware products, let’s talk! Feel free to book a demo [here](https://calendar.app.google/AHhzPK3LRhwZFBHC6)

If you have hardware products you love, but the customer support sucks, tell us about it [founders@telemetron.ai](mailto:founders@telemetron.ai)\
